source.label: Notifications issued under section 52(1) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (GST Council tax repository)

note: Section 52(1) sets only a ceiling; the collected rate is fixed by notification, and each notification fixes ONE leg. Notification 52/2018-Central Tax fixes the CGST leg at "half per cent. of the net value of intra-State taxable supplies"; notification 15/2024-Central Tax substitutes "0.25 per cent." for "half per cent." with effect from its publication on 10 July 2024. The settlement file withholds TCS as TCS-CGST + TCS-SGST on an intra-State supply, or TCS-IGST on an inter-State one, and all three map to LineKind.TCS, so what a detector recomputes is the AGGREGATE: twice the CGST leg. That is what percent_bp encodes. This resolves RS3 open item 5: the secondary sources reporting "1% to 0.5%" and "0.25%" are both right, the first quoting the aggregate and the second the CGST leg. Both rules are verified:false on that account: a rule is verified only where the primary page for the number it encodes was read, and the number encoded here is a doubling, not a figure any page states. The SGST and IGST notifications, read, would make it verified:true unchanged.

citation.label: Notification No. 52/2018-Central Tax, 20 September 2018: electronic commerce operators collect "half per cent." of the net value of intra-State taxable supplies (CGST leg). Aggregate encoded here is the CGST leg doubled; the mirroring SGST and IGST notifications were not read in this session, so the aggregate is derived and this rule is verified:false on the number it encodes. valid_from is that notification's ISSUE date and NOT a read commencement date: section 52 was brought into force by a separate notification, which was not read in this session, so the start of this window is unverified and left as issued rather than corrected to a date no primary source in this session supports. The whole window sits below the coverage floor (16 March 2026), so no lookup returns this rule; it is history, and a lookup inside it is UNCOVERED.

Notification No. 15/2024-Central Tax, 10 July 2024: for the words "half per cent.", the figure and word "0.25 per cent." shall be substituted; in force from the date of publication. Aggregate encoded here is the CGST leg doubled; the mirroring SGST and IGST notifications were not read in this session, so the aggregate is derived and this rule is verified:false on the number it encodes. The CGST leg itself, and this rule's valid_from, were read off the notification above.
